visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair walks confidently toward the camera on a brick-paved path. She wears a tight, sleeveless beige midi dress, large dark sunglasses, and carries a small grey quilted handbag. The setting is outdoors under the dappled shade of a large green tree. In the background, a building with colorful amusement park-style posters and several people sitting on a white bench are visible under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium shot as she stops walking. She adjusts her sunglasses with her right hand, showcasing a polished manicure. She poses by looking directly at the lens, then tilts her head slightly, maintaining a confident, neutral expression. (3) A cut shifts the scene to a medium shot where she stands before a dense wall of vibrant green fern-like plants and a rockery. She is seen from the side, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a soft smile. (4) Another cut shows her in a similar garden setting from a different angle. She runs her hand through her hair, turning her body slightly to show the fit of her dress. The lighting is bright and high-contrast, highlighting her silhouette and the textures of the foliage. (5) In the final phase, she performs a slow turn away from the camera, her long hair fanning out. She then looks back over her shoulder one last time before the video ends, with sunlight filtering through the trees behind her.
